extraction.teacher_style: The instructor demonstrates Changa tuki steps while dancing alongside students in an informal outdoor setting. Instruction is primarily through visual demonstration and peer mimicry rather than verbal breakdown.

lesson_structure.note: Instructor and students dancing changa tuki steps outside.

steps_taught.name: Changa tuki basic
steps_taught.description: Footwork involving quick foot rotations and steps to music.

what_works: Visual group demonstration allows students to follow along.
what_hinders: Lack of verbal breakdown or counts makes learning specific footwork difficult.

evidence_segments.observation: Dancers practicing footwork steps together in an outdoor courtyard.

extraction.distinctive_method: Informal group practice where students learn entirely by watching and dancing next to the instructor.
